objective: Reproduce the WATcloud tangent-conditioned equivariant Stanford development experiment on one AWS L40S under the same 22 GiB comparison envelope without opening the locked test set.

execution_changes_from_source_experiment: AWS EC2 g6e.2xlarge target instead of WATcloud trpro-slurm2
NVIDIA L40S target instead of NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
persistent encrypted EBS and private S3 instead of WATO Drive
direct Docker launch instead of SLURM
permitted_without_new_experiment_id: select patch_nodes using the registered AWS VRAM sweep
use fp16 only if a documented bf16 operator failure occurs
resume an interrupted job from its latest complete checkpoint
synchronize immutable bundles, logs, checkpoints, and reports to the registered private S3 prefix
requires_new_experiment_id: change patient split or staged cases
change model architecture, loss weights, optimizer, learning rate, seeds, or masks
change the registered GPU family or 22 GiB comparison envelope
inspect or evaluate a locked test case
select hyperparameters using final cross-validation results

data.normalization: recomputed independently for each fold from its eight training patients under the primary target mask

patch_protocol.training_seed_region_selection: uniform among supported regions present in the selected patient, then uniform among that region's nodes
patch_protocol.explicit_aneurysm_policy: retain in global loss and report separately; do not use as an equal sampling stratum because cohort support is inadequate
patch_protocol.patch_selection_rule: largest candidate completing paired forward/backward, validation, checkpoint save, and resume with peak allocated VRAM <= 22.0 GiB

model.name: EquivariantSurfaceGNN
model.output: wall-tangential transient WSS vector in Pa

loss.regional_aggregation: 0.5 * global node mean + 0.5 * unweighted mean of per-region means over supported region ids present in the patch
loss.sparse_region_policy: region ids 5 and 6 contribute through the global component only

evaluation.test_set_policy: do not mount, inspect, normalize with, or evaluate locked cases during this experiment

hardware.persistent_storage: encrypted gp3 EBS mounted under /mnt plus private versioned S3
hardware.spot_policy: disabled until an interruption watcher and S3 checkpoint sync pass a deliberate interruption test

launch_gates: AWS manifest is derived from the original freeze without changing the runtime tree
staged case set equals the 12 development cases exactly
locked case directories are absent from the staged canonical root
all automated tests pass in the AWS container
actual GPU name matches the registered NVIDIA L40S contract
selected patch passes forward, backward, validation, save, and resume
peak allocated VRAM is at most 22.0 GiB
losses, gradients, predictions, and metrics are finite
fold-specific normalization contains no validation or locked patient
a deliberate interruption resumes without resetting optimizer, scheduler, scaler, step, or RNG state
results synchronize to the registered private S3 prefix before instance shutdown
